verdict.rationale: Scheduled recurring runs, such as periodic drift detection or plan/apply jobs, are a fair question for an infrastructure-automation tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only one-off CLI commands (plan, apply, test, import) and code-defined resource management, with no recurring scheduler. The 'automate your development workflow' claim is about managing GitHub repositories as code, not scheduling jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
